title: E-mail · To: Kenji Mori · From: Alison Grant · Date: March 3 · Subject: Visit to our Toronto office · Itinerary · Kenji Mori · Toronto · E-mail · To: Alison Grant · From: Kenji Mori · Date: March 4
L: (1) E-mail · To: Kenji Mori · From: Alison Grant · Date: March 3 · Subject: Visit to our Toronto office
We are delighted that you will visit our Toronto office next week.
On your first full day with us, our product team will show you the new packaging line.
On the second day, you will meet with our purchasing director to discuss next year's order.
If you would like to tour the city during your free afternoon, my assistant, Ben, would be happy to show you around.
2:30 P.M. — Arrive at Toronto Pearson Airport; car to the Lakeshore Hotel
9:00 A.M. — Product team presentation on the packaging line
10:00 A.M. — Meeting with purchasing director Ruth Feld
(3) E-mail · To: Alison Grant · From: Kenji Mori · Date: March 4
Everything looks fine, but I have one request.
My colleague in Osaka needs my report by Wednesday morning, so I would prefer to spend my free afternoon at the hotel rather than touring the city.
Please thank Ben for his kind offer.
I look forward to seeing you next week.
